name: London Luton Airport

runway.quote: Work on the 2.16km runway commenced each night at 00:01 and completed by 05:45

hours.quote: LLA holds a 24 hour licence to operate and there is no ban on night flights.

curfew.v: no night ban (24-hour licence), but a night quota period 23:30-06:00 local time with movement limits and quota counts; older-generation jets are not allowed at night
curfew.quote: Night Quota Period: 2330 – 0600 local time. Departures 2315 – 0545 local time (inclusive) Arrivals 2330 – 0600 local time (inclusive)

noise.v: night flights are controlled through lower noise violation limits, movement limits and a quota count system
noise.quote: Each specific aircraft type is assigned Quota points based on how noisy it is.

slots.v: every fixed-wing flight needs a runway slot allocated in advance; at short notice outside ACL's hours, contact the airport's Operations Control Centre
slots.quote: no fixed wing aircraft flight is permitted to operate without the prior allocation of a runway slot.

handling.v: business aviation handled by Signature Flight Support (two sites) and Harrods Aviation
handling.quote: Harrods Aviation is the leading London-based business aviation service provider.

missing: runway designation, width and exact length in m
notes: UK AIP could not be read. 'none': true for curfew means only that the operator states there is no ban on night flights; night restrictions (older jets banned, quota count, 79 dB(A) night noise limit) still apply, so do not write 'no restrictions'. The night period hours were not found on a readable page. ACL pages do not say explicitly that business aviation needs slots, only that Luton is Level 3. Handling company names: the website rule says the site names no companies except authorities, airport operators and cited sources, so these are for internal use. | 2026-10-27 run: UK AIP not readable. Night quota times are from Luton Local Rule 1 on the ACL site, marked 'Adopted: 2015' (still the published rule). Night shoulder period also defined: departures 05:50-06:45, arrivals 06:00-07:00 local. Luton's 'Procedures for Requesting Prior Permission to Operate' PDF could not be opened (see unreadable). Slots replaced: the old quote was only a name in an ACL list; the airport's Charges and Conditions of Use 2026 (V7, effective 1 Jan 2026) states the slot rule directly. Same document names the operator as London Luton Airport Operations Limited (company 03491213) and says Border Force handles customs and immigration, but gives no customs hours. The 32 miles in 'location' is the airport's own travel-page figure (likely road distance, no compass direction), not the AIP figure. The runway article of 30 Mar 2026 gives only '2.16km', no designation or width.
